 "content": "def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    n, m = len(g), len(g[0])
    # The two diagonally opposite color-pairs extend inward/outward as rays.
    # Find the central 2x2 block, then grow diagonals from colored endpoints
    # (on opposite sides) toward the corresponding board edges.
    cells = [(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(n) for c in range(m) if g[r][c] != 0 and g[r][c] != 2]
    # Each ray begins at the colored point nearest the central block and follows
    # its diagonal away from the block, preserving the color.
    for r,c,color in cells:
        if color == 2: continue
        # direction selected by relative location to central pattern
        # upper-left pair projects to upper-left, upper-right to upper-right,
        # lower-left to lower-left, lower-right to lower-right.
        dr = -1 if r < n//2 else 1
        dc = -1 if c < m//2 else 1
        rr, cc = r+dr, c+dc
        while 0 <= rr < n and 0 <= cc < m:
            if g[rr][cc] == 0: g[rr][cc] = color
            rr += dr; cc += dc
    return g
"
}

    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    n, m = len(g), len(g[0])
    # Continue each diagonal sequence from every nonzero colored marker.

            while 0 <= rr < n and 0 <= cc < m:
                if g[rr][cc] == 0:
                    g[rr][cc] = color
                rr += dr
                cc += dc
